environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on EKS 1.28 in us-west-2. Pod uses IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) with a scoped role. Cluster has a Cilium CNI with a CiliumNetworkPolicy that applies L3/L4 egress filtering: pods in namespace 'microservices' can only reach CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 and specific external CIDR allowlist (CDN ranges for jsdelivr.net resolved via external-dns). The policy uses a toFQDNs rule with matchPattern '*.jsdelivr.net' and toCIDR for internal services. The link-local range 169.254.0.0/16 is explicitly in the egressDeny section. Additionally, the node group has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens: required, hop-limit: 1) which prevents container-level IMDS access even if network policy were bypassed. SRI attributes on dashboard scripts ensure CDN-served JavaScript integrity verification at the browser level, preventing supply-chain injection via SSRF-based cache poisoning of CDN responses.

config.network_policy: CiliumNetworkPolicy with egressDeny to 169.254.0.0/16, egress allow only to 10.0.0.0/8 and toFQDNs *.jsdelivr.net
config.iam: IRSA with minimal role, no node-level credential exposure
config.sri: integrity attributes on all external script tags with sha384 hashes
